text_block_list.text: After a day out…
choice_data_list: This time I'll make sure you have fun!
This time I'll make sure you have fun!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: …Sigh.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Look, I didn't have any fun the last time you tried to play a game with me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Stop with the kiddy games. It's not gonna happen.
Sure—last time ended in failure—but today, I have an ace up my sleeve. I know all about the game she's been obsessed with recently.
RDLI is a PvP FPS developed overseas. What makes it fun is the wide arsenal of weapons players can use to outwit their opponents.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I thought I was the only one around here who plays it…
I heard from Super Creek that Narita Taishin's been grumbling about not having anyone to play with.
I stand little chance of beating an experienced player like her, but she'll probably enjoy it if I put up a good enough fight.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Fine. I accept your challenge.
I'm a little unsettled by how readily she accepts my offer, but I charge into battle nevertheless, ready to give the fight of my life.
YOU LOSE.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: That's another win for me. I'm five for five now.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Yeah? I mean, I do play a lot.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Anyway, you had a lot of nerve challenging me despite being trash at the game.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: You choose terrible weapons and stages, and you suck at using the NPCs. Did you even change the settings to match your play style?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: This is my first time playing PvP mode, so I was looking forward to it, but playing against you is disappointing as hell.
Narita Taishin is rarely this chatty. She seems to be in a good mood now that she's found someone to wipe the floor with.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: It's no fun like this… Want me to make things easier for you?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Wow, no hesitation. Don't you have any pride?
choice_data_list: I just want to keep hanging out with you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh?
If I keep losing so easily, she's going to get bored. I'll gladly throw away my pride to give her a better match.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Do you hear yourself? You are seriously have no shame at all.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I'll only use the default weapons, and you can borrow one of my SSRs. If you still can't win, then you're a lost cause.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hmph, whatever.
YOU LOSE.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I knew you couldn't do it.
Even after countless rematches, I just can't win against her. I try to apologize for being a terrible partner, but she cuts me off.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: It's fine. We can play again some other time.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: The rewards they give out for winning PvP matches are pretty good. Plus, crushing you is kinda fun.
Her words are harsh, but at least she's giving me a chance.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hmm? You really think you can beat me without any boosts?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Then you should just ask for a handicap. It'll even the playing field.
choice_data_list: This game is super fun, so I want to try winning by myself.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I thought you were gonna complain about being bad at strategizing, not getting the controls, or that the game's too violent and scary.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: If you say so. Give me your best.
She seems to be in an even better mood, but…

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
choice_data_list: Uh… What does this item do again?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ugggh! Stop!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I'm getting ticked off just watching you play! You should use that item you got earlier and…

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: See? Now you get more health back. Restoration items are vital to winning.
choice_data_list: I see now! You're incredible, Taishin!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: …This is, like, the most basic of basic knowledge.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Whatever. Agh, look at the time! I've wasted the whole day with you!
choice_data_list: Thanks for teaching me so much, Taishin!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I don't need your thanks! I'm leaving!
She leaves in a huff, but I'm glad I got to play so many rounds against her.
